'''June 2001 Ventura tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local (booster draft) held in Ventura, California on 2 June 2001. It is known from Wilson Fisher's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2401">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-02-ventura-6-2-01d2401/ ventura-6-2-01], DeckTech (Wilson "Your mom" Fisher, 2 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-02-ventura-6-2-01d2401/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Ventura, California
* '''Players:''' 6
